name: Age-matched meme relative reversal
hypothesis: Buy recent residual losers only after their own recovery trigger and hedge a matched eligible basket.
spec: Setup: Tokens of similar maturity may temporarily overshoot one another. Entry: Buy recent residual losers only after their own recovery trigger and hedge a matched eligible basket. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit at residual normalization or a widening stop. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs hedgeable short legs or float estimates for memecoins
